name: Thud Ridge – Phuc Yen
notes: Elevation is a 2010s surface model (trees and buildings included), resampled; voids clamped to sea level.
Land cover is 2021; built-up land is repainted as cropland so modern cities do not appear in 1967.
Núi Cốc reservoir (1970s): water repainted as land (0.31 % of the tile).
